effective_status_note: The MCIS register lists the norm as «Хүчин төгөлдөр» (2026-09-21) and its PDF is the «Албан ёсны 2 дах хэвлэл» (second official printing, cover year 2022) of the 2011 norm, stamped by MCIS on 2025-10-27. No legalinfo.mn page for order №84/2011 was located (source/SOURCE.json U1), so later amendments have NOT been checked; the PDF prints no amendment note and no «мөрдөх огноо» (effective-from date).

applicability.evidence: section 1 — барилга байгууламжийн өрөө, тасалгааны дулаан хангамж, халаалт, агаар сэлгэлт, кондиционерийн системийг төлөвлөхөд мөрдөнө; exclusions listed in the same section (a–…)

capability_level_note: L0 registry + L1 full text + L2 clause/table/appendix structure from the official PDF text layer (auto-extracted; measured 2026-09-21: 355 clauses, 40 tables, 50 definitions, 40 references, 77 numeric candidates). L3 compute: 4 numbered formulas catalogued («(1)–(3)» in §5.6, «(Л.12)»), none executable. The MCIS stamp draws a page border that pymupdf reads as a full-page grid — the parser re-detects tables inside it; several appendix tables are therefore partial (Ж.1 lost its first header column, Б.1/И.1/Р.4 are caption_only). The l2/ explanation layer is NOT built (build-l2 fallback check fails on 7.11.13 — LOST_NUMBER 150). See parsed/parse_report.json and tests/.

source.page_numbering_note: The document prints NO page numbers (measured 2026-09-21: text layer carries only the running header «БНбД 41-01-11»; rendered pages 10 and 72 show no folio; the printed contents page has no page column). Citations therefore use the PDF page index (offset 0) — the number a PDF viewer shows.

verification.note: No clause has been verified by a human against the page image yet. Numeric rules therefore stay non-executable (searchable + citable only).
